description: Implementation class of ObsService for managing Observations, including save, retrieve, and delete operations, as well as handling complex observations and registered handlers.

classes.name: ObsServiceImpl
classes.description: Default implementation of the ObsService interface managing creation, retrieval, update, deletion, and complex handling of observation data.

methods.name: saveObs
methods.description: Saves or updates an Obs object after performing privilege checks and handling complex concept data.

methods.name: getObs
methods.description: Retrieves an Obs object by its ID, handling complex data if necessary.

methods.name: voidObs
methods.description: Voids an Obs, marking it as deleted for historical purposes.

methods.name: purgeObs
methods.description: Permanently deletes an Obs, including associated complex data if applicable.

methods.name: getObservations
methods.description: Fetches a list of observations based on various filters such as person, encounter, concepts, date range, and more.

methods.name: getObservationCount
methods.description: Returns the count of observations matching specified criteria.

methods.name: getObsByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an Obs by its UUID, handling complex data if necessary.

methods.name: getRevisionObs
methods.description: Returns a previous revision of an Obs, if available.

methods.name: getComplexObs
methods.description: Returns a complex Obs in a specified view.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Gets a complex obs handler for an Obs, based on the concept or key.

methods.name: getHandlers
methods.description: Returns the current map of registered complex obs handlers.

methods.name: registerHandler
methods.description: Registers a new complex obs handler by key.

methods.name: removeHandler
methods.description: Removes a registered handler by key.
